name: sa_plugin_ts
help:
usage: ts <command> [options]
       sa ts <command> [options]

Commands:
  lower      [file.ts] [--out <file>] [-p <package>]
  check      [file.ts] [-p <package>]
  build      [file.ts] [--out <file>] [-p <package>]
  build-exe  [file.ts] [--out <exe>] [-p <package>] [<sa-build-exe-args>...]
  test       [file.ts] [-p <package>] [<sa-test-args>...]
  init       [path]
  skills     [--json]
  help

Options:
  -p, --package <name>   Select a workspace package (accepted; single-file lowering)
  --out, -o <file>       Write output to file
  --json                 Emit JSON where supported
  -h, --help             Show this help message
